semantics.authority: Current confirmed fields govern. Historical/proposed values never override current requirements. Open decision IDs gate dependent implementation.
semantics.combat_phase_mapping: Spawning-combat income/drain is confirmed; map cleanup separately using D03. Mine pause income is zero; tower pause drain is open.

waves.count_note: Nominal counts derive from 5 per second for 60 seconds. Cap/backlog policy remains open; do not silently reduce rate or scheduled count.

inherited_explicitly.warning: Inherited reference only; not new balance approval. Hero death no longer ends the redesigned run.

proposed_engineering_contract.completion: atomic debit and activation; guard duplicate completion
proposed_engineering_contract.visuals: read gameplay progress; animation durations are not gameplay timings
proposed_engineering_contract.currency: Ledger deltas must match approved events without race-created money. D02 decides debt/zero-wallet behavior; no floor is silently imposed.
proposed_engineering_contract.run_identity_guards: Stale events cannot mutate an ended or replacement run; implementation mechanism is not prescribed.

mine_income_during_cleanup.paired_decision: D03 also decides cleanup tower drain separately.

decision_register.title: Tower drain rate
decision_register.question_and_constraints: What gold/sec does each completed tower consume? Combat-only, including idle towers, is confirmed. No numeric rate is approved; 0.1 gold/sec remains a proposal. Blocks economy balance and A05/A06.

decision_register.title: Low and zero wallet
decision_register.question_and_constraints: At insufficient gold, do towers stop, accrue debt, or follow another rule? Decide all-at-once versus priority allocation, partial payments, firing effects, debt limits if any, and re-enable behavior after income/rewards. Blocks A06/A09.

decision_register.title: Economy clocks
decision_register.question_and_constraints: Does mine income continue during Clearance? Does tower drain continue then? Decide separately, including intentional net farming. Mine setup/pause income and tower setup drain are zero; tower pause drain is still open. Blocks A05/A06/A13.

decision_register.title: Construction duration and decay
decision_register.question_and_constraints: Choose tower and mine build seconds, decay rate or duration, any decay delay, and upgrade timing when upgrades are defined. Animation lengths choose none of these. Blocks A07/A08.

decision_register.title: Purchase affordability and ordering
decision_register.question_and_constraints: May unaffordable work start? At completion without enough gold, does progress hold, decay, fail, or follow another rule? Order same-tick income, drain, construction, and reward transactions. Blocks A09/A15.

decision_register.title: Build eligibility and interruptions
decision_register.question_and_constraints: Choose range, facing, line of sight, target selection, one versus multiple active/partial sites, and whether B construction is allowed in Setup, Spawning, and Clearance. Define movement away, target/hero switch, death, menus, pause, and exit effects. Only B release decay/resume is fixed. Blocks A07/A08.

decision_register.title: Y confirmation behavior
decision_register.question_and_constraints: Choose decay, interruptions, UI placement, dead-hero eligibility, and how input rearms between waves. Required outcome: a distinct manual 3 second confirmation for every wave, no automatic restart from carried progress or a stale callback. Blocks A10.

decision_register.title: Spawn boundaries and population cap
decision_register.question_and_constraints: Choose first/last spawn timing, live cap, and exact deferred demand handling. Five/sec for 60 seconds gives nominal 300. Explain cap behavior without silently skipping actors, changing rate, or extending the spawning window. Blocks A11/A12.

decision_register.title: Enemy composition
decision_register.question_and_constraints: Choose the first pass role mix and any boss inclusion. Five/sec remains unchanged on all ten waves. This does not settle HP scaling or boss scheduling under D12. Blocks A11/A16.

decision_register.title: Breaches and clearance
decision_register.question_and_constraints: How does an actor removed by a base breach satisfy the kill-all/clearance requirement? Keep base loss separate. Define killed/breached/alive/deferred count conservation and wave completion exactly. Blocks A12/A13/A15.

decision_register.title: Tower targeting and projectile rules
decision_register.question_and_constraints: Choose range, target priority, first-shot timing, reacquisition/retarget cooldown behavior, projectile speed and trajectory, collision/obstruction, and damage timing. One visible arrow every 0.5 seconds and 50 damage are fixed. Blocks A16/A17.

decision_register.title: HP interpretation and bosses
decision_register.question_and_constraints: Does 100 HP cover every initial normal role, and how do later waves change it? Decide retained armor/shields/mitigation, raw versus net 50 damage, wave growth, boss presence/stats/schedule, and their interaction with breach rules. Do not promise universal two-hit kills. Blocks A16.

decision_register.title: Dead-state enemy speed
decision_register.question_and_constraints: Choose the speed multiplier and whether/when it resets on revival. Decide repeat-death stacking or replacement. Enemies must be faster while the hero is dead; no value is approved. Blocks A18.

decision_register.title: Revival and dead controls
decision_register.question_and_constraints: Choose respawn location, HP, immunity, clock/pause handling, camera/control behavior, hero switching while dead, and treatment of active abilities/buffs/projectiles and construction. Keep the 5 second auto revive and Beta skip. Decide dead-hero wave confirmation with D07. Blocks A18/A19.

decision_register.title: Upgrade content
decision_register.question_and_constraints: Mine upgrading uses hold B, but levels, costs, outputs, and visuals are undefined. Arrow-to-cannon progression is future intent only. Decide these separately before exposing an upgrade purchase; do not carry old tiers forward. Blocks upgrade-specific extensions of A07/A09.

decision_register.title: Sites and geometry
decision_register.question_and_constraints: Decide rear wall buildability and exact coordinates, spacing, collision and interaction pads for added sites/mine. Preserve one route, both walls, and its clearance. Four front plus eight approach sites are approved; rear sites are additional only if approved. Blocks A01/A02.

decision_register.title: Fractional ledger and display
decision_register.question_and_constraints: Choose accrual/debit granularity, precision, rounding, and shown gold precision. Preserve rate totals across frame rates. Decide simultaneous transaction ordering with D05, not by incidental callback order. Blocks A05/A06/A09.

decision_register.title: HUD completion
decision_register.question_and_constraints: Choose gold/wave display positions, final portraits/icons, affordability/depletion feedback, and coexistence with other ability indicators. Bottom-center hero portrait/health/LMB/RMB and switch refresh are fixed. Attack-icon placeholders are already acceptable. Blocks final visual A20.

decision_register.title: Profiles and allies
decision_register.question_and_constraints: Confirm Beta/Hard exposure and inherited integrity differences under the new opening economy. Decide any ally availability/cost changes separately; enemy exclusion from attacking allies does not remove allied systems. Existing hero abilities/progression remain. Blocks profile and economy regression A21.

decision_register.title: Terminal precedence
decision_register.question_and_constraints: Decide base failure versus final enemy clearance/reward on the same tick; pending projectiles; hero death/revive concurrent with victory; and what happens to active transactions on terminal transition. A hero's zero HP cannot itself defeat the run or prevent victory. Blocks A15/A19/A22.

acceptance_contract_source: Readable handoff section 10, A01–A22; these are pending/testable contracts, not claims of passing gameplay tests.
